evaluation_revision_note: Dependency checks and privileged oracle diagnostics added after initial evaluation; sealed weights, forecasts and performance settings were unchanged.

experiment.scope: Observation-only weights over reachable reduced-physics states, preserved across counterfactual impact plans. Not a calibrated continuous posterior or a novel/general 3D world model.
protocol: Generate fresh history groups, disjoint from both earlier action-head datasets; fit preprocessing on training prefixes only.
Supervise state weights with barycentric discretization of training history peaks. Validation state targets select energy temperature and epochs. No future response labels are used to fit weights.
Masked empirical-prior energy weights form a baseline. Small bounded residual networks may reweight accepted states; no correction is allowed when all observation scores are identical.
Belief inference accepts only prefix evidence, observed probe and frozen prefix features; future impacts, bank indices and response labels are prohibited inputs.
Seal weights and full candidate states at the observation cutoff before reading a future plan. Continue each candidate without clearing hidden history.
Keep candidate trajectories and failure events separate. Mixture means are statistical summaries, never a new simulated state or rendered physical trajectory.
Report MAP trajectory error, mixture-mean error, path energy score, marginal CRPS, failure Brier, entropy and measured candidate-band coverage.
All methods share candidates and simulator budget; finite candidate bands are not confidence guarantees. Reserve any later design changes for new holdouts.

features.input: observed four-frame RGB prefix and its foreground mask only

limitations: One fixed camera, material, geometry and prescribed interface; synthetic supervision of history-grid weights.
State targets are a barycentric grid encoding, not observations of a true discrete posterior.
Energy temperature and residual epochs use validation state labels only; no future outcome or test label tuning.
Mixture-mean error describes a statistical summary; it is not an additional physically reachable trajectory.
A nominal 90% weighted candidate band has finite support and no confidence or coverage guarantee; measured coverage is reported.
Correlated frames and average sensor residuals form an empirical energy, not an exact independent-pixel likelihood.
Learned features, state hypotheses and physical rollout integration are conventional components; novelty and 3D validity are not established.
Many action variants reuse one prefix; test forecast count is not the number of independent history groups.
